headline: Cochlear targets return to 18% EBIT margin over medium term as Nucleus Nexus rollout exceeds 95% uptake in developed markets
reasoning: Cochlear's Nucleus Nexus system has achieved more than 95% uptake across developed markets, with patient appeal driven by a smaller external device and future-proofed hearing strategy access. The company is working to return its EBIT margin back to its historic 18% level over the medium term. For FY27, management expects low single-digit growth across all developed markets, describing the recovery as a gradual improvement rather than an overnight rebound. Continued R&D investment is highlighted as key to building longer-term growth potential through new products in the pipeline.
quote: We are working towards returning our impact margin back to its historic 18% level over the medium term. Overall, if FY 27 outlook, how would you describe that? We expect low single digit growth next year, and we expect growth in all of our different developed markets. Now that's a part the work that we're doing in order to deliver on our strategies about helping people understand and be able to take advantage of those referral pathways. It's also about continuing to invest in our R&D pipeline so that we build that long term future growth potential with a whole bunch of more exciting products that are still in development.
episode_title: Cochlear looks to tune up its margins
